# [GOV] W13: GPU verdict + measurement-debt calendar

**Status:** PROPOSED
**Issue Type:** `GOVERNANCE`
**Change Class:** `CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE` (verdict + calendar, no code)
**Labels:** `type:governance`, `triage`, `risk:low`
**Owning Authority:** ANA LISTE A3 (R03 UNKNOWN), V8.6 §12 (GPU FREEZE) + §21 (measurement plan)
**Milestone:** V8.6 — Production Recalibration (Phase 4)

## 1. Objective
(a) GPU (`backend/gpu.rs` 856, feature-gated, zero value-evidence): KEEP-gated or DELETE. (`cubecl` excluded: pre-release.) (b) Calendar for every audit-flagged missing measurement: bench outputs, cache hit-rates, mutant-kill runs, G5 speedup (W7), render timings (W6).

## 2. Scope
Verdict + dated measurement list with owners. No code.

## 3. Normative Traceability
- R1: no `gpu-probe`/`gpu-parity` outputs on record; default build GPU-free.
- R2: V8.6 §21.1 metrics (owned-commodity LOC, adapter LOC, warm edit-to-test, replay time, recon diffs → 0).

## 4. Reuse / Invariants
FREEZE default holds until a measured workload + speedup requirement exists.

## 5. Failure Semantics
Unmeasured GPU work PR → SCOPE REJECTED (G10).

## 6. Verification Gate + Receipt
Gate: verdict + calendar ratified. Receipt: record.

## 7. OPEN_PIN triggers
A real f64-probe result appears → verdict reopens with receipt.

## 8. Sequence
Independent. Closes R03 UNKNOWN.
title: [GOV] W13: GPU + measurement-debt schedule
